evals.prompt: hey can you write me a telugu christian song about jesus's love and sacrifice on the cross? i need it for suno ai, maybe around 3 minutes long. make it emotional and devotional, something our church youth group can sing
evals.expected_output: A Telugu Christian song with proper Suno AI formatting ([Intro], [Verse], [Chorus], etc.), focused on Jesus's love and the cross, with emotional and devotional lyrics in Telugu script, standard structure with bridge, approximately 20-30 lines total

assertions.name: Has proper Suno AI formatting with section tags
Uses Telugu script throughout
assertions.description: All lyrics must be in Telugu script (తెలుగు), not English transliteration

assertions.name: Focuses on Jesus's love and cross sacrifice
assertions.description: Lyrics must mention the cross (సిలువ), Jesus's love (ప్రేమ), sacrifice, and related themes

assertions.name: Appropriate length for 3 minutes
assertions.description: Song should have 20-30 lines of lyrics (not counting section tags)

assertions.name: No musical direction notes in parentheses
assertions.description: Should not include notes like (Soft piano) or (Guitar solo) - lyrics only

assertions.name: Saved to .txt file
assertions.description: Output must be saved as a .txt file

evals.prompt: i want to create a praise song in telugu for our sunday worship service. the theme should be about god's grace and mercy. keep it simple and easy to sing, not too long. format it for suno ai please
evals.expected_output: A simpler Telugu Christian song formatted for Suno AI, focusing on God's grace (కృప) and mercy, with straightforward structure (2 verses, chorus, outro), easy-to-sing lyrics in Telugu script, approximately 15-20 lines

assertions.name: Has proper Suno AI formatting
assertions.description: Song must include section tags like [Intro], [Verse], [Chorus], [Outro], [End]

assertions.name: Uses Telugu script
assertions.description: All lyrics in Telugu script, not transliteration

assertions.name: Focuses on grace and mercy theme
assertions.description: Lyrics must mention grace (కృప) and mercy (దయ) as central themes

assertions.name: Simple and short structure
assertions.description: Should be 15-20 lines, simpler structure without complex sections

evals.prompt: Generate a telugu worship song about victory in Christ and overcoming through faith. I'm uploading this to suno to create music for our church's annual conference. Make it powerful and declarative, with a strong chorus that people can remember easily
evals.expected_output: A powerful Telugu Christian song formatted for Suno AI, theme of victory (విజయము) in Christ, declarative and strong tone, memorable chorus with repetition, standard or extended structure with impactful bridge, approximately 25-30 lines

assertions.name: Victory theme with powerful tone
assertions.description: Lyrics must emphasize victory (విజయము), overcoming, and faith with declarative language

assertions.name: Memorable repetitive chorus
assertions.description: Chorus should have repetition and be easy to remember
